title: Guess The Word
description: Guess a secret word from a list of candidates by using a feedback function that returns the number of matching characters at the same indices.
pseudocode:
1. candidates = wordlist
2. while candidates is not empty:
3.   guess = getBestGuess(candidates)
4.   matches = guess(guess)
5.   if matches == 6: return
6.   candidates = filter(candidates, guess, matches)

steps.note: Initialize candidates with the full wordlist.
Pick a word that minimizes the maximum number of candidates remaining (Minimax strategy).
Call master.guess() and receive feedback (e.g., 2 matches).
Filter candidates: keep only those with the same feedback match count against 'acckzz'.
Select next best candidate from the filtered list.
